title: Split Two Strings to Make Palindrome
description: Determine if you can form a palindrome by splitting two strings a and b at the same index and concatenating prefix of one with suffix of the other.

steps.note: Initialize pointers i=0, j=len-1 for strings 'ulac' and 'jalu'
Compare a[0]('u') and b[3]('u'). Match! Increment i, decrement j.
Compare a[1]('l') and b[2]('l'). Match! Increment i, decrement j.
Pointers crossed. Check if remaining substring of a or b is palindrome.
Checking remaining substring 'ac' from string a. Not a palindrome.
Checking remaining substring 'ja' from string b. Not a palindrome.
Return false, no valid split found.
